audience: project managers and teams that plan tasks, dependencies and time in GanttPRO

useCases.title: List projects and tasks
useCases.text: List the projects of the team, then list tasks with filters. Open one task to read its fields.

useCases.title: Check fields, calendars and resources
useCases.text: Read the task fields, including custom fields, and the project calendars with working days. List the resources that can be assigned.

useCases.title: Review comments and time logs
useCases.text: List the comments and the time logs on one or more tasks.

useCases.title: Read dependencies and team members
useCases.text: Open one dependency link between two tasks. List the team users, or open one user.

useCases.title: Create or change tasks
useCases.text: Create a task in a project, or change only the fields you pass on one task. Repeating the same update leaves the task the same.

useCases.title: Add comments, time logs or links
useCases.text: Add a comment or a time log to a task, or create a dependency link between two tasks. Each call creates a new record.
